page.overview:
Who is BeeLee Amdas?

BeeLee Amdas was a female Balosar who lived around thirty years after the Battle of Endor. She was betrayed and killed by her partner, Ryn Biggleston, who had poisoned her drink with the intention of taking her share of a cash pool.
